Interior Design Across Delhi NCR and Beyond

9th Corner works from its head office in Pitampura, Delhi, and its branch in Gurgaon. From these two bases, our designers, architects and project managers serve clients across Delhi NCR and in Karnal. Every location has its own housing types, building rules and lifestyle, and over 22 years and more than 800 completed spaces, we have learned to design for each of them. Whichever area you are in, the process is the same: a detailed brief, photorealistic 3D visualisation, transparent milestone-based pricing, fixed timelines and a 10-year warranty.

Interior Designers in Delhi

Delhi's homes range from heritage bungalows and builder floors to modern apartments, often with very different layouts and structural limits. As interior designers in Delhi, we plan carefully around existing structures, local building rules and the needs of extended families. Our work covers homes, offices, showrooms and salons across the city. Explore our Delhi page.

Interior Designers in Gurgaon

Gurgaon is known for high-rise apartments, independent villas and modern office towers. Our Gurgaon branch makes it easy to visit sites and supervise work closely. As interior designers in Gurgaon, we work on luxury apartments, villas and corporate offices, combining contemporary design with practical storage and smart lighting. Explore our Gurgaon page.

Interior Designers in Noida

Noida's growing residential sectors and commercial hubs bring a steady demand for modern apartments, family homes and workplaces. As interior designers in Noida, we plan compact and mid-sized homes to make the most of every square foot, and design offices that support growing teams. Our Rana Residence and Anand Residence projects show our work in Noida. Explore our Noida page.

Interior Designers in Chhattarpur

Chhattarpur is home to many of Delhi's farmhouses and large estates. As interior designers in Chhattarpur, we design relaxed, generous interiors that connect with gardens, verandas and pools. See our farmhouse interior designer service. Explore our Chhattarpur page.

Interior Designers in Rajokri

Rajokri, near the Delhi-Gurgaon border, is another popular farmhouse and villa belt. We design weekend retreats and family homes here, balancing rustic character with modern comfort. Explore our Rajokri page.

Interior Designers in Hauz Khas

Hauz Khas combines established South Delhi homes with a lively design and dining scene. As interior designers in Hauz Khas, we work on elegant residences and boutique commercial spaces where character and detail matter. Explore our Hauz Khas page.

Interior Designers in Pitampura

Pitampura is home to our head office, so we know its homes and commercial spaces well. We design apartments, builder floors and offices across the area and nearby North and West Delhi. Explore our Pitampura page.

Interior Designers in Karnal

Beyond Delhi NCR, we also serve clients in Karnal, designing independent houses, farmhouses and commercial spaces with the same process and standards we follow in the capital. Explore our Karnal page.

What Our Clients Across the Region Have in Common

Our clients live and work in very different places, from high-rise apartments in Gurgaon and Noida to farmhouses in Chhattarpur and family homes in Pitampura and Karnal. What they share is a wish for spaces that are beautiful, practical and delivered without stress. That is why our process does not change from one location to the next. Every client receives a detailed brief, a space plan tested before anything is built, photorealistic 3D views, a clear milestone-based quote, a fixed timeline and supervised execution on site.

Local knowledge still matters, and our team brings it to every project. Knowing which materials are readily available, which suppliers deliver reliably to each area and how local conditions such as dust, heat and monsoon humidity affect finishes helps us choose wisely and keep work on schedule.

Services Available in Every Location

Wherever you are, you can access our full range of work: residential interior design, architecture, office interiors, showroom design, salon interiors, furniture design and Vastu. See all our services.

How We Manage Projects in Different Locations

Distance should never mean less attention. For every project, a dedicated project manager coordinates the site team, schedules deliveries and checks quality at each milestone. You receive regular updates on progress, and key stages are reviewed on site. Because drawings, materials and quantities are fixed before work begins, the project stays on track even when you cannot visit the site yourself.

We also understand that each location brings its own practical challenges. Apartment societies may restrict working hours and lift use. Farmhouses outside the city need careful planning of material deliveries. Older buildings in established neighbourhoods may have structural limits that shape what is possible. We plan for these realities from the start, so they do not become surprises halfway through the job.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the process the same in every location?

Yes. Every client receives the same brief, 3D visualisation, transparent milestone-based quote and fixed timeline, whether the site is in Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon or Karnal.

Can I meet the team in person?

Yes. You are welcome to meet us at our head office in Pitampura or our branch in Gurgaon, and our designers also visit your site during planning.

Will my project get the same warranty?

Yes. Every project carries our 10-year warranty, wherever it is located.

Not Sure If We Cover Your Area?

If your project is outside the locations listed here, get in touch anyway. Book a free consultation and we will tell you honestly whether we can serve your site well.
